name: DMCC SPECIALITY CHEMICALS LIMITED

verdict_notes: margin fell QoQ and is not up YoY

annual_report.business: DMCC Speciality Chemicals Limited is an integrated speciality chemicals manufacturer with expertise across sulphur, boron and ethanol chemistry, catering to industries such as pharmaceuticals, detergents, dyes, pigments, cosmetics, water treatment and industrial applications.

capacity_or_capex.item: Boric Acid production capacity increase at Dahej plant
Production line capacity increase at Roha plant
Waste heat recovery system in oleum section (pinch technology)

guidance_or_targets.statement: The Company carries no major capital expenditure obligations and has the assets, capabilities and capacity to grow as conditions normalise.
